steps: Entered CO-UKR-MAYA1 under Play a seed
Played 12 months, mostly accepting cabinet picks
Read verdict, achievements, moments, truth, ranking, share card
scenarios.notes: Knew at the end why I lost: Washington relations 28.5 of 33 and UK 88 of 93.

steps: Finished whole Flashpoint without getting stuck
Started New world from the share card page
scenarios.notes: Mission failed, grade D, but no moment of being stuck.

friction.happened: Button opens a field that is hidden until tapped; the first tap looked like it failed in the driver, field has a placeholder of a different code

friction.expected: A Map switch next to Focus/Full desk
friction.happened: Map was only inside the hamburger Menu; Focus/Full desk looked like the only view choice
Dozens of markers, layer icons and a Guide button; the useful part was the bottom strip with Review recommended
The sound button overlaps Main menu and Skip text on every reveal stage

friction.expected: Button named after the current stage
friction.happened: Bottom-right button names the next stage (Achievements then The moments), my click by label failed twice

friction.expected: New game to be a button
friction.happened: It is a grey centered label; the real buttons are Replay same opening and New world. New world was not obviously a new game
Land for a promise seemed to show for two consecutive screens (result screen then the next month); I could not tell if it was the same crisis again
Underlined names with an i helped; 2 names chip was clear
Better than 0% of simulated competent leaders, Best known run 730: fine but heavy on numbers; the Truth stage terms Declassified, nuclear program estimate not meaningful to me
Capital sat at 5-6 unspent most months because accepting only the crisis pick used none; this probably cost me Washington and UK

bugs.title: Sound button overlaps Main menu and Skip in reveal header on phone
steps: Look at top bar of any reveal stage
bugs.actual: Sound icon covers Main menu text and Skip

suggestions.what: Put Map next to Focus/Full desk
On Focus desk, after the crisis pick, say once 'you have 6 capital unspent and Washington is falling' with one-tap accept of the recommended orders
Make Main menu and the New world button obvious at the end: one big Play again button

delight: Result card with a Trump quote after my first choice (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/maya-phone/009-r1.png)
Review recommended list in Map mode is clear (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/maya-phone/017-rev.png)
The count: one square per month (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/maya-phone/038-v1.png)
The truth stage: your estimate crossed out (devloop/instances/world-conflict/runs/iter-03/shots/maya-phone/048-e4.png)

fun.reason: Quick and tidy, but I mostly tapped Accept cabinet pick and lost anyway.

clarity.reason: Always knew the next tap; the verdict said exactly what I missed.

visual.reason: Illustrated scenes and chronicle look great on phone.

feels_like_a_game.reason: Cards feel like Reigns; the map and numbers feel like a dashboard.

agency.reason: Never blocked, but I did not realise the crisis choice alone would not win.

replay.reason: Beat 470 is a hook, but I would want to know what to do differently.

recommend.reason: Fine for a commute, ending is satisfying, the loss felt avoidable.

verbatim: I lost and I understand why, which is more than I can say for most games. I wish it had nudged me about Washington earlier.
